decision: D-EV-1 (owner, 2026-11-11): a Haiku-class external model through a dedicated CI key, seed data only. The USD 5 nightly cap is SHARED with Ragas (D-EV-2): garak's share and the model's price live in evals/cost-meter/ (shares.json, prices.json), never here.

plannedTurn.basis: A heavy assistant turn: system prompt, tool specs, a 2000-character probe and several tool results in, a long answer out. An ESTIMATE until the Phase 0.4 baseline measures the p99 turn from the decision log; replace it with the measured figure then.

rolesBasis: The roles that can reach the assistant. A READER (and an AUDITOR) is refused by the AI feature gate (feature-gate.ts predicate 3: canWrite) before any guard or model call, so garak has nothing to probe there; the workflow checks that refusal with one request instead.
